articles.headline: Suter, Neighbours and McTavish score 2 each as the Blues rout the Senators 7-2
articles.description: — Pius Suter, Jake Neighbours and Mason McTavish each had a pair of goals to lead the St. Louis Blues to a 7-2 win over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: Kraken beat Flyers 3-2 in shootout as Philadelphia’s winless start reaches 8 games
articles.description: — Bobby McMann scored a goal in regulation and then added the game-winner in the fifth round of the shootout as the Seattle Kraken beat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: Brady Tkachuk's natural hat trick helps Panthers end skid
articles.description: On the NHL's Frozen Frenzy night, the Tkachuk brothers fed right into it, as Brady Tkachuk had a natural hat trick, while his brother Matthew Tkachuk matched a club record with five assists, as the Florida Panthers beat Columbus Blue Jackets 7-3 Tuesday.
